provenance.source: Canonical RKM architecture documentation and supported identity entity types

entityTypes.label: Technique
entityTypes.description: A reusable Retrieval-Augmented Generation method, strategy or algorithmic approach represented as a first-class RKM entity.

entityTypes.label: Framework
entityTypes.description: A software framework that supports, implements or orchestrates Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems or related workflows.

entityTypes.label: Paper
entityTypes.description: A scholarly or technical publication used to describe, justify or evaluate concepts in the RAG ecosystem.

entityTypes.label: Component
entityTypes.description: A reusable architectural or implementation part of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system.

entityTypes.label: Pattern
entityTypes.description: A recurring design pattern or structural arrangement used across RAG systems and implementations.

entityTypes.label: Glossary Term
entityTypes.description: A canonical terminology entry that defines vocabulary used by RKM contributors, schemas and documentation.

entityTypes.label: Dataset
entityTypes.description: A structured collection of data used for retrieval, training, evaluation or benchmarking in RAG contexts.

entityTypes.label: Benchmark
entityTypes.description: A standardized evaluation task, suite or protocol used to compare RAG systems, models, datasets or techniques.

entityTypes.label: Embedding Model
entityTypes.description: A model that converts text or other content into vector representations for retrieval, ranking or comparison.

entityTypes.label: Language Model
entityTypes.description: A language model used for generation, reasoning, transformation or evaluation within RAG systems.

entityTypes.label: Vector Database
entityTypes.description: A database or search system specialized for storing, indexing and querying vector embeddings.

entityTypes.label: Graph Database
entityTypes.description: A database or storage system specialized for representing and querying graph-structured data.

entityTypes.label: Retriever
entityTypes.description: A component or system responsible for retrieving candidate information for a Retrieval-Augmented Generation workflow.

entityTypes.label: Reranker
entityTypes.description: A model, component or method that reorders retrieved candidates according to estimated relevance or utility.

entityTypes.label: Chunking Strategy
entityTypes.description: A strategy for dividing source content into retrieval units that can be indexed, embedded or assembled as context.

entityTypes.label: Evaluation Metric
entityTypes.description: A metric used to assess retrieval, generation, grounding, relevance, faithfulness or other RAG quality attributes.

entityTypes.label: Prompt Technique
entityTypes.description: A prompting method or template pattern used to guide model behavior in RAG-related workflows.

entityTypes.label: Agent
entityTypes.description: An autonomous or semi-autonomous system component that plans, invokes tools or coordinates steps in a RAG workflow.

entityTypes.label: Provider
entityTypes.description: An organization, platform or service provider that supplies RAG-relevant models, infrastructure, tools or data services.

notes: This registry is limited to entity types already accepted by schema/definitions/identity.schema.json.
